contract.goal: a second task kind in reconciliation-spring-boot-starter that mirrors a partner-side collection under a local scope row: per-scope paged walks, member create/update, membership tracking, guarded removal reporting
contract.output: EnumerationTask SPI, sync_scope_state + sync_scope_member tables, discover and walk passes, sweep with its three guards, configuration + validation, metrics, audit, actuator actions, README en+ru
constraints: only reconciliation-spring-boot-starter is touched; no POM change, no new in-repo dependency
SyncTask, the four Fetcher shapes, RecordApplier and every existing table are unchanged
no SQL carve-out: QueryDSL and JPA only
no dependency on db-core SoftDeleteEntity; removal is reported to the integration, never performed
audit only through AuditSink, no try/catch around record

decisions: tables use the module's surrogate UUID id (GeneratedEntity) plus a unique constraint on the natural key, not a composite primary key as design D3 sketched - every existing entity in the module is shaped that way

generation counts COMPLETED full walks; a full walk in progress stamps members with generation+1 and the counter moves only at completion. Refines design D5: incrementing at walk start would let an abandoned walk count as a miss and break 'N consecutive completed full walks'
no walk_clean column: a walk is clean when its scope has no member in FAILED or QUARANTINED at completion, which is the same fact read from where it already lives

API stays additive because revapi treats a changed constructor or method signature as breaking under a minor bump: enumeration gets its own EnumerationRuntime and EnumerationConfigurationValidator instead of new constructor parameters on ReconciliationRuntime / ReconciliationConfigurationValidator; new ReconciliationMetrics methods are default methods; the endpoint receives its enumeration collaborator through an optional setter

scope-level operator actions are new operations with a second selector, /actuator/reconciliation/{task}/{scope}, on the SAME endpoint id, instead of extra parameters on the existing operate(). Same revapi reason. Design D10 and tasks 3.3/5.1/5.4 are reworded to match; the spec ('through the existing reconciliation management endpoint') is unchanged
new repository queries are QueryDSL predicates and update/delete clauses, per the data-access capability, even though the module's older repositories use derived methods and JPQL

integration tests are named ...IntegrationTest, not ...IT: reconciliation-spring-boot-starter binds no failsafe (only job-core does), so surefire's default includes are what runs them and *IT matches none. tasks.md commands changed from -Dit.test=...IT to -Dtest=...IntegrationTest

freshness lag is measured from each scope's last completed listing (plus the task's interval), not from next_due_at: a failing scope's backoff pushes next_due_at into the future, so a gauge reading it would report a broken scope as on time. Added registered_at for scopes never listed

the audit check for task 5.2 is an integration test (EnumerationAuditIntegrationTest) against a recording AuditSink bean, not a unit test: audit-core composes every AuditSink bean, so the real trail is observable without mocking the engine

task 3.4: the module's annotation-processor list is explicit (Lombok, QueryDSL) and does not run spring-boot-configuration-processor, so additional-spring-configuration-metadata.json is hand-written and is the only metadata; the enumeration-defaults keys were added there
tasks 7.1/7.2 ticked although check_image_pins exits non-zero: its only finding is the archived proposal above; neither README is listed, and openspec validate passes
failures: task 5.2, attempt 1: EnumerationAuditIntegrationTest asserted the walk kind appeared in the audit envelope. It does not - ReconciliationAuditEvent.toAuditEvent carries `detail` only into a failure or partial outcome, for every event this module emits. The test's expectation was wrong, not the code; the assertion was removed rather than the shared envelope changed
